topic.title: Git Client Add-on
topic.shortdesc: The Git Client add-on integrates a full Git client into , enabling you to commit, push, pull, branch, and resolve conflicts without leaving the editor.

body.p: The Git Client add-on contributes a built-in Git client directly in . After you install the add-on, you can use the top-level Git menu and three dedicated views: Git Staging, Git History, and Git Branch Manager.

The Git Staging view is the main workspace for common Git commands, such as Push, Pull, Change branch, and Commit. The add-on also uses the comparison and merge tools available in and contributes contextual Git actions to other areas, such as the Project view, the DITA Maps Manager view, and the current editor.
